num_periods: int, number of periods H, must be at least 1; all period axes use indices t=0,…,H-1, corresponding to periods 1,…,H in the mathematical model.
num_customers: int, number of customers N, must be at least 1; customer-axis index c=0,…,N-1 corresponds to customer node number c+1 in the routes.
num_vehicles: int, number of homogeneous vehicles M available in each period, must be at least 1; the vehicle axis uses indices k=0,…,M-1, and all vehicles have the same capacity.
num_scenarios: int, number of demand scenarios S, must be at least 1; S=1 denotes deterministic demand.
scenario_probabilities: list[float], length S; scenario_probabilities[s] is the positive probability of scenario s, and all elements must sum to 1.
demand_scenarios: list[list[list[float]]], shape [S][H][N], in units of product quantity; demand_scenarios[s][t][c] is the nonnegative demand of customer node c+1 in period t under scenario s. Two scenarios whose demand prefixes up to t are identical are regarded as having the same observed history.
initial_inventories: list[float], length N+1, in units of product quantity; index 0 is the plant and index i=1,…,N is customer node i, giving the known inventory at the start of the planning horizon.
inventory_capacities: list[float], length N+1, in units of product quantity; index 0 is the plant's maximum inventory capacity and index i=1,…,N is the maximum inventory capacity of customer node i. Each initial inventory must lie between 0 and the corresponding capacity.
production_capacity: float, maximum production quantity of the plant in each period, in units of product quantity per period, must be nonnegative.
vehicle_capacity: float, maximum total load of each homogeneous vehicle in each period, in units of product quantity, must be positive.
setup_cost: float, fixed cost incurred by performing a production setup in any period, in units of currency per setup period, must be nonnegative.
unit_production_cost: float, cost of producing one unit of product, in units of currency per product unit, must be nonnegative.
holding_costs: list[float], length N+1, in units of currency/(product unit·period); index 0 is the plant's unit end-of-period inventory holding cost and index i=1,…,N is the unit end-of-period inventory holding cost of customer node i.
unmet_demand_penalties: list[float], length N, in units of currency per unmet product unit; unmet_demand_penalties[c] is the penalty cost per unit of unmet demand in the current period for customer node c+1.
transportation_costs: list[list[float]], shape [N+1][N+1], in units of currency per vehicle arc; transportation_costs[i][j] is the cost for one vehicle to travel directly from location i to location j. Index 0 is the plant and 1,…,N are customers; the matrix must be nonnegative, symmetric, and have a zero diagonal.
